principles.default: One canonical shared Tyz's Skills trait with per-mod adapters and optional tenfold 99-rank tiers; Pufferfish remains for non-overlapping one-time choices.
principles.singular: Permanent once-only Monk effects (Step Assist, Elytra/Momentum Gliding and original unique techniques) stay in native Vampirism faction tree.
principles.leveled: Monk faction license gates Monk-specific tiered Tyz purchases via cancellable PurchasePre; global shared Tyz traits remain purchasable for non-Monks; no duplicate paid rank.
principles.source_skills: The 172 preliminary attribute and special-effect rows are candidate adapters, not necessarily 172 distinct paid upgrades after unification.
principles.category_gating: Tyz skillPrerequisites tests only ownership of prior skill, not level 99. Server SkillActionEvent.PurchasePre checks previous level==99 and the relevant Monk license; test ordinary and bulk purchases.
principles.rank_investment: 99 levels per Tyz skill; default 5 cumulative tenfold tiers for truly repeatable stats (optional sixth if needed), only one finite tier for bounded traits; prices and values arrays each require exactly maximumLevel entries.
principles.anti_duplication: Tyz owns leveled canonical source modifiers; Pufferfish must not simultaneously provide the same numeric reward. Each tier uses its own valid ID, with additive values and native effective caps.
principles.revocation: If eligibility is lost, suspend Monk-only effects and further Monk-specific investment; preserve earned ranks securely pending defined transition/respec, no silent player-data deletion.
principles.refunds: RefundPre rejects refunding an earlier tier while a later tier has any ranks, and respec must respect Monk licenses and external equipment effects.
